Build upper-body strength and muscular endurance in just 15 minutes with this military-style dumbbell workout — one pair of dumbbells, no gym required.
A lot more workouts like this on the Gritty Soldier app. Full, structured plan, and ill guide you for every workout and every exercise:
Whether you're a Soldier looking for a quick garage-gym PT session, building strength at home, or just want an effective upper-body dumbbell workout, hit play and get it done.
